description: A caseworker needs a structured way to notice when a client situation is drifting from manageable instability toward immediate crisis instead of reacting only once a clear emergency occurs.

user_profile.persona: 41-year-old senior case manager used to handling many non-crisis cases that can worsen suddenly
user_profile.context: The warning signs tend to emerge gradually and are easy to overlook when each change seems small on its own
user_profile.communication_style: Calm and threshold-oriented, wants patterns and escalation triggers named clearly

fact_sheet.fact: Senior Case Manager Maria Garcia's employee ID at Hope Harbor Community Services (HHCS) is MG-7845.
Maria Garcia is responsible for a caseload of 45 clients, primarily in the 'Stable but Vulnerable' category.
Maria Garcia's direct supervisor, who must be notified of Orange-level alerts, is David Chen, Director of Case Management.
HHCS uses a proprietary software called the 'Beacon Client Stability Tracker' to monitor client well-being.
The login URL for the Beacon tracker is https://hhcs.beacon-tracker.com.
The Beacon system tracks five key stability domains: Housing, Financial, Health & Wellness, Social Support, and Employment.
Each stability domain in Beacon is scored on a scale from 0 (Critical Crisis) to 100 (Fully Stable).
The Beacon system automatically calculates a client's Overall Stability Score, which is a weighted average of the five domain scores.
IT support for the Beacon system is available by emailing beacon.help@hhcs.internal or calling extension 555.
Client John Miller (ID: JM-2023-04B) is assigned to caseworker Maria Garcia.
John Miller's baseline Overall Stability Score on March 1, 2024, was 82.
John Miller's 'Financial' domain score dropped from 75 to 55 on March 15, 2024, after he logged a reduction in work hours.
John Miller missed a scheduled therapy appointment on March 20, 2024, which lowered his 'Health & Wellness' score from 90 to 70.
As of March 22, 2024, John Miller's Overall Stability Score is 68, down from 82 at the start of the month.
A 'Yellow Alert' is triggered in Beacon when a client's Overall Stability Score drops below 70.
John Miller's profile triggered a 'Yellow Alert' on March 22, 2024, which automatically sent an email notification to m.garcia@hhcs.org.
The standard operating procedure for a 'Yellow Alert' requires the assigned caseworker to make phone contact with the client within one business day.
An 'Orange Alert' is triggered when a client's Overall Stability Score drops below 50.
An 'Orange Alert' requires an in-person wellness check within 48 hours and a mandatory case review meeting with the supervisor.
A 'Red Alert' is triggered when any single domain score drops below 20, regardless of the overall score.
A 'Red Alert' activates the immediate crisis response protocol, which involves notifying the on-call crisis intervention specialist, Dr. Susan Reed, at 555-212-9876.
Maria Garcia is required to log all client interactions related to an active alert in the Beacon 'Alert Resolution Log' within 3 hours of the interaction.
The Beacon system generates a 'Weekly Watchlist Report' every Monday at 8:00 AM, listing all clients with active Yellow or Orange alerts.
The monthly performance metric for senior caseworkers is to resolve at least 90% of Yellow Alerts before they escalate to Orange status.
All caseworkers must complete the 'BCN-101: Introduction to Beacon Tracker' online training module before gaining system access.
The advanced training module, 'BCN-205: Proactive Intervention Strategies,' is mandatory for all senior caseworkers and is held quarterly.
The next session for 'BCN-205' is scheduled for April 18, 2024, in Conference Room 3B at the main office located at 123 Aspen Way, Riverbend.

user_needs.description: What is the current Overall Stability Score for my client John Miller (JM-2023-04B), and what was his baseline score at the beginning of the month?
Which specific stability domains for John Miller have declined this month, and what events were logged that caused the score changes?
user_needs.prediction_reason: Intra-group: After learning the overall score has dropped, the natural next question is to ask for the specific reasons and contributing factors for the decline.

user_needs.description: Based on his score drop, what specific alert was triggered for John Miller and on what date?
user_needs.prediction_reason: Intra-group: Understanding the specific score changes logically leads to asking about the formal alert status that resulted from them.

user_needs.description: For a Yellow Alert, what is the required immediate contact action and deadline?
user_needs.prediction_reason: Intra-group: Once the alert level is identified, the immediate need is to know the required action protocol.

user_needs.description: What is the score threshold for the next level, an Orange Alert, and what actions does it require?
user_needs.prediction_reason: CROSS-GROUP: After understanding the required actions for the current alert, a proactive caseworker will want to know the threshold and requirements for the next level of escalation to anticipate future risk.

user_needs.description: What is the trigger for an immediate crisis Red Alert?
user_needs.prediction_reason: CROSS-GROUP: After learning about the Yellow and Orange alert thresholds, the user may want to complete their understanding of the escalation framework by asking about the highest-level alert.

user_needs.description: For an active alert, where in Beacon must client interactions be logged and within what deadline?
user_needs.prediction_reason: CROSS-GROUP: After learning the required action (make phone contact), the user's next procedural thought is about the documentation and reporting requirements for that action.

user_needs.description: What is the monthly performance metric related to resolving Yellow Alerts?
user_needs.prediction_reason: Intra-group: Thinking about the requirement to log alert resolutions can naturally lead to curiosity about how those resolutions are measured for performance evaluation.

user_needs.description: How can I get a summary of all my clients with active Yellow or Orange alerts?
When and where is the next advanced training on 'Proactive Intervention Strategies' being held?
